description: Remove environment variables from a project. Takes effect on the next deploy, or immediately with apply: true. On failure, follow error.details.retry: idempotencyKey "reuse" means the outcome is unknown, so call again with the same idempotencyKey (it resumes or replays the original request instead of starting a second release); "new" means the release already failed, so call again without idempotencyKey or with a new one (the old key only replays that failure); waitFirst means call project_status until no operation is running before retrying.

apply.description: Serve the new environment now by restarting the live release.

idempotencyKey.description: Reuse this exact value when retrying. Generated when omitted.

name: unset_env
